project_type: Multi-system emulator shipping as ONE artefact: a sideloadable iOS .ipa installed through TrollStore. Rust engine (crates/emulator-bridge) behind a UniFFI Swift facade plus five libretro core dylibs dlopened at runtime. This task changes ONLY the Swift iOS shell under native/ios/, extending the cover art system that stage 3 (commit 4a8a682) built: the name ladder in GameArtwork.swift, the fetch/store/negative-cache in ArtworkStore.swift, and the server-list fallback search in ArtworkIndex.swift.
language: Swift (the only language this task touches). Rust is READ ONLY and must stay byte-identical. YAML for native/ios/project.yml.
build_system: XcodeGen reads native/ios/project.yml and emits Continuum.xcodeproj (gitignored). targets.Continuum.sources is an EXPLICIT per-file list: ContinuumApp.swift, MetalCanvas.swift, TouchControls.swift, PlayerScreen.swift, LibraryShell.swift, LibraryCards.swift, SettingsScreen.swift, GameDetailSheet.swift, GameArtwork.swift, ArtworkStore.swift, ArtworkIndex.swift, GameMetadata.swift, build/Generated. A NEW .swift file that is not added there is SILENTLY never compiled: the app builds, installs, launches, and the feature does not exist, with no error anywhere. The only real iOS compiler on this project is the orchestrator's GitHub Actions run on macos-latest.
test_framework: cargo test for the engine (74 tests, default features). There is no Swift test target and no iOS SDK on this host, so Swift is verified two ways: (1) swiftc -frontend -parse per file, which is a SPELL-CHECKER ONLY and does not type-check SwiftUI/UIKit/Foundation; (2) the offline harness at .work/artwork-probe/, which EXTRACTS the pure declarations verbatim out of native/ios/*.swift with make-harness.py and RUNS them on Linux (currently 73 checks, exit 0). The harness is how every pure rule in the artwork system is actually proven; it is gitignored scratch (/.work/ in .gitignore) and must be extended by this task, not bypassed.
build_command: No iOS build is possible on this host (no macOS, no Xcode, no iOS SDK). The build gate is: cd native/ios && for f in *.swift; do swiftc -frontend -parse "$f" || echo FAIL $f; done  (every file exits 0), plus python3 -c "import yaml,sys;yaml.safe_load(open('native/ios/project.yml'))".
test_command: cargo test (expect 74 passed, 0 failed) AND cd .work/artwork-probe && python3 make-harness.py && swiftc -O -o harness Extracted.swift main.swift && ./harness (expect exit 0, every check ok).
verification_instructions: (1) swiftc -frontend -parse on EVERY .swift file under native/ios/, each exit 0. Because this does NOT type-check SwiftUI/UIKit, review by eye: async/await, @MainActor isolation, no @Published mutated off the main actor, task-per-key races (the dictionary check and the task insert must have NO await between them), and Sendable captures. (2) Every new or renamed file appears under targets.Continuum.sources in native/ios/project.yml, project.yml still parses as YAML, and `ls native/ios/*.swift` has zero files absent from that list. (3) cargo test -> 74 passed. (4) .work/artwork-probe harness rebuilt and run, all checks ok, including the new ones this task adds. (5) Live end-to-end network check with curl against thumbnails.libretro.com for the Krusty case and for one cross-system case, recording HTTP status, Content-Type and byte size. (6) git diff --name-only master must list only native/ios/** and .agents/tasks/**.
snapshot_or_generated_files: UniFFI Swift bindings are generated into native/ios/build/Generated/ (gitignored, never committed). Continuum.xcodeproj is generated by xcodegen (gitignored). .work/artwork-probe/Extracted.swift is generated by make-harness.py and is gitignored scratch. Nothing generated is committed.
setup_instructions: Nothing to install. swiftc 6.3 (Linux, x86_64), cargo 1.92.0 and python3 are already on the host. The harness needs no SDK: it compiles Foundation-only extracted code. Saved copies of the real thumbnails.libretro.com listings live in .work/artwork-probe/*-index.html and .work/coverlists/gg-*.html; re-fetch with curl if missing.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN: thumbnails.libretro.com is reachable and every server fact in this plan was measured with curl from this host. No macOS, no Xcode, no iOS SDK, no device, no simulator: the .ipa build and every on-device behaviour are verified only by the orchestrator's CI run. Do NOT push, do NOT open or modify a PR, do NOT trigger CI. Commit locally on the EXISTING branch ios-ui-player-controls (PR #4 into master is already open; commits a69ca5a stage 1, c266dbc stage 2, 4a8a682 artwork coverage pass 1).
contribution_requirements: Swift only, under native/ios/, plus native/ios/project.yml to register new files. Do NOT touch crates/**, scripts/**, .github/**, web/**, native/ios/build-engine.sh or native/ios/package-ipa.sh. No em dashes anywhere (code, comments, strings, commit messages): use a comma, a colon or a full stop. Every failure path writes a distinct, specific status string; no silent aborts. Comments explain WHY, in the voice the existing artwork files use. Commit locally with a clear message; never push.
key_patterns: THE TWO BUGS THIS TASK FIXES, both measured against the live server from this host. BUG 1: the fallback list search only ever downloads Named_Boxarts. ArtworkCoverLists.download hardcodes ThumbnailFolder.boxart via ArtworkNames.listingURL's default argument, and ArtworkCoverLists.fileURL keys the persisted JSON on the system alone ("gg.json"), so a system has exactly one list and it is always box art. The direct ladder walks all three folders; the LIST SEARCH, which exists for names the ladder cannot derive, sees only one. BUG 2: ArtworkIndexNames.match is an exact equality of normalised titles, and for the failing game the titles genuinely differ by a SERIES PREFIX: the file on disk is "Simpsons, The - Krusty's Fun House (U) [!].gg" which normalises to "simpsons the krustys fun house", and the server's Game Gear entry is "Krusty's Fun House (USA, Europe).png" which normalises to "krustys fun house".  ||  CORRECTION TO THE BRIEF, MEASURED: Game Gear Named_Boxarts DOES now carry "Krusty's Fun House (USA, Europe).png" (GET -> 200, image/png, 678613 bytes). It is present in all three folders (titles 2241 bytes, snaps 2202 bytes). So on today's server BUG 2 alone blocked this game, and with both bugs fixed the auto-pick is the BOX ART, which is the better outcome. The repository gains thumbnails over time, which is exactly why BUG 1 still has to be fixed: a game whose art exists only in Named_Titles or Named_Snaps is unreachable by the list search today.  ||  MEASURED LISTING SIZES (HTTP 200, text/html;charset=UTF-8): Game Gear boxart 240387 / titles 235007 / snaps 236587 bytes (858 / 834 / 846 png names, folding to 409 / 428 / 428 normalised titles). NES boxart 4054023 / titles 4859773 / snaps 4861401. Game Boy boxart 442588 / titles 453856 / snaps 452026. Box art listing bytes for all nine systems, ascending: sms 153572, gg 240387, gb 442588, gbc 452020, genesis 618548, snes 970863, gba 1769226, ps1 2550183, nes 4054023; total 11261410 (10.7 MB).  ||  INVARIANTS THAT MUST SURVIVE UNCHANGED: substitution-not-strip in ArtworkNames.sanitizeForLibretro; the name-major ladder with its regionTranslated and regionAppended rungs and its dedupe; the 3-at-a-time ArtworkGate around cover lookups (and NOT around list downloads); the one-week negative cache in UserDefaults key continuum.artwork.misses.v1; artwork stored in Application Support/Artwork, never Documents, excluded from backup; cover lists in Application Support/Artwork/CoverLists; ArtPlate drawn UNDER real art always; sweepLibrary resolving every game without it being opened, one at a time, with generation bumped in batches of four; the disclosure in Settings that filenames are sent to thumbnails.libretro.com; one download per key enforced by a task dictionary with NO await between the read and the insert; ArtworkDisk.clear() skipping directories so clearing covers does not delete the lists.  ||  THE TWO KEYS: ArtworkDisk.key(forPath:) is a 64-bit FNV-1a of the absolute path and is the key for the cover file, for continuum.artwork.misses.v1 and for continuum.artwork.sources.v1 (provenance). Anything new that is per-entry state uses the same key function.  ||  PURE CODE MUST BE EXTRACTABLE: .work/artwork-probe/make-harness.py finds a declaration with the regex ^(public )?(enum|struct|final class) <Name>\b and copies to the first column-0 closing brace. New pure logic therefore has to live in a COLUMN-0 enum or struct with no UI imports in its body, or the harness cannot run it.
